drafts.description: A photograph dating approximately to 1927 - 1929 from Kaldakhvara, Abkhazia, featuring folk singer and storyteller Shach Chukbar (left) playing the apkhartsa, a two-stringed bowed instrument, at the bedside of the sick Khoza Ampar, with Alexa Ampar on the right.
